Pre-order pricing of $4,499 reflects $1,000 off the standard $5,499 MSRP, available for a limited time until the MPUV is officially released.

01 / Overview

A Whole New Category of E-Bike

The HPC MPUV (Multi-Purpose Utility Vehicle) isn't just another cargo bike — it's an entirely new breed of e-bike. Designed from the ground up to be the highest load capacity e-bike on the market, the MPUV was originally engineered for the world's most demanding military applications and refined for the rider who refuses to compromise. Hunters hauling out elk quarters. Overlanders strapping down a week's worth of gear. Commuters carrying groceries, kids, and a passenger. Adventure enthusiasts going where no other bike can follow. The MPUV was built to do it all — and it does it better than anything else in its class.

Like every HPC, the MPUV is hand-built in our USA warehouse to your exact specifications. With over 18 years of experience and 20,000+ riders behind us, we've packed every piece of hard-won engineering knowledge into this platform. The result? The most practical, capable, and high-performance utility e-bike on the planet.

02 / Cargo Capability

Insane Load Capability — Haul More Than You Ever Thought Possible

This is where the MPUV leaves the competition in the dust. The custom, fully removable rack system was engineered specifically for this platform, giving you a modular, mission-ready load-out that can be configured for hunting trips, overlanding adventures, urban hauling, or stripped clean for a fast trail ride.

250lb

Rear Rack

100lb

Front Rack

350lb

Total Payload

300Nm

Torque to Move It

Combine that load capacity with up to 300Nm of torque from the Bafang M620 / M630 mid drive system, and you've got a machine that climbs the steepest grades fully loaded without breaking a sweat. Haul more gear. Catch bigger game. Even haul a passenger. The MPUV makes it look easy.

03 / Modular Mounting

Custom MOLLE Panels — Carry Anything, Anywhere

To unlock the full potential of the rack system, the MPUV will be available with custom HPC MOLLE panels that mount directly to the front and rear racks. Inspired by tactical and military gear systems, MOLLE compatibility means you can attach any accessory you want — your bike, your gear, your way. The MPUV adapts to your mission instead of forcing you to adapt to it.

Tool Rolls Dry Bags Ammo Cans Hydration Packs Panniers Rifle Scabbards First Aid Fishing Holders Camera Cases + Any 3rd-Party MOLLE Accessory

04 / Power System

Three Power Levels — Tune the MPUV to Your Mission

The MPUV runs the proven Bafang M620 and M630 mid drive motors — the same battle-tested platforms that power our Scout and Titan. Choose from three power configurations to match your terrain, your load, and your riding style. Whether you want a lightweight, efficient daily commuter or a 3500W cargo-hauling beast, the MPUV scales to your mission.

Tier 01

750W

48V System

Efficient, lightweight, and Class-3 friendly. Ideal for commuters, light cargo duty, and riders prioritizing maximum range over peak power.

Tier 02

2500W

52V System

The sweet spot. Massive torque and hill-eating capability with excellent range. The go-to choice for hunters, overlanders, and serious cargo haulers.

Tier 03 — Flagship

3500W

60V System

Maximum power, maximum capability. The most powerful mid-drive setup ever offered on an HPC utility platform — built for the rider who refuses to compromise.

Paired with our custom controller and firmware, every MPUV — regardless of power tier — reacts to rider input thousands of times per second, multiplying your pedal power into effortless, surge-on-demand performance. Whether you're crawling up a fire road with a buck strapped to the back rack or sprinting through traffic with a full pannier load, the MPUV delivers seamless, predictable, brutally capable power.

05 / Chassis & Geometry

Lightweight Despite the Capability

Here's the part nobody else can match: at just 74 lbs fully equipped with the front and rear rack system, the MPUV is substantially lighter than comparable cargo and utility e-bikes. The secret is the aerospace-grade hydroformed aluminum frame — we didn't just bolt racks onto an existing platform, we engineered the chassis from scratch to handle extreme loads while keeping the bike nimble, balanced, and a joy to ride. The mid-step design means you can step through easily, even with bulky gear loaded on the front rack.

Most utility e-bikes feel like riding a tank. The MPUV feels like riding a high-performance e-bike that just happens to carry 350 lbs of cargo.

06 / Build Spec

Premium Components Tip to Tail

This isn't a budget cargo build. The MPUV is loaded with the same premium spec philosophy you'd expect from any HPC.

Magura Quad-Piston Brakes

Unmatched stopping power, even fully loaded with 350 lbs of cargo.

150mm Front Suspension

Soaks up rough terrain, washed-out fire roads, and every curb you didn't see coming.

27.5+ or 26 x 4.0 Fat Wheels

Choose your terrain weapon — plus-size for trail, fat for sand, snow, and beyond.

Belt Drive Capable

Low-maintenance, silent operation. No grease, no chain stretch, no stains.

Rohloff E-14 Compatible

The gold standard in cargo and overland drivetrains. Bulletproof. Built for life.

Custom Removable Rack System

Modular front and rear racks engineered specifically for this platform.

07 / Range

Massive Range — Standard or Extended Battery

We know utility riders demand range. The MPUV ships with a standard battery tray supporting up to 1300Wh for daily duty, and an optional extended battery tray supporting up to 1800Wh for the adventure rider, hunter, or overlander who needs to disappear off-grid for days at a time. Like every HPC battery system, these are USA-made using only premium cells, backed by our industry-leading 3-year warranty.

08 / Legal Compliance

Class 1/2/3 Legal — With Fully Unlocked Off-Road Mode

Stay legal on the bike path, then unlock the full beast for off-road adventure. The MPUV is fully Class 1, 2, and 3 compliant out of the box, with a fully unlocked "off-road" mode available for private land, trails, and off-grid use. YOU decide how the bike performs.

09 / Built For

Anyone Who Demands More

The MPUV was purpose-built for the people who push their bikes the hardest:

Adventure Enthusiasts

A do-everything platform that goes anywhere.

Hunters

Haul gear in and game out of the backcountry.

Overlanders

Multi-day, off-grid expeditions without compromise.

Commuters

Serious cargo capacity for everyday duty.

Cargo Haulers

For riders who've outgrown conventional cargo bikes.

Anyone

Who refuses to compromise between performance, capability, and practicality.

Originally developed for military applications and field-tested under the most stringent conditions imaginable, the MPUV brings that same battlefield-grade durability to civilian riders.

10 / The HPC Difference

Why HPC?

Designed, engineered, and assembled in the USA — including our battery systems

One-man-one-bike build process — your MPUV is built specifically for YOU

18+ years in business, 20,000+ riders served

Industry-leading 3-year warranty

GSA contract holder — trusted by US Special Forces, Army Corps of Engineers, and US Air Force

Premium components only — Magura, Bafang, Rohloff-compatible, and USA-made batteries

The MPUV Is in a Class of Its Own

There is literally nothing on the market like the MPUV. More power, more capacity, lighter weight, better components, and a build process that no overseas mass-producer can match. If you want the most capable utility e-bike money can buy — built right here in the USA to your exact specifications — pre-order your MPUV now at $4,499 and save $1,000 before launch.

Pre-Order Your MPUV
